home.manifesto: A West that knows how to tailor.
home.manifestoBody: Fashion West Ukraine is a platform for the designers of Transcarpathia. We gather people who turn wool, linen and leather into a language. We show not collections — but the force of the western edge, its restraint and precision.
home.featuredDesignersSub: Six names the platform begins with
home.latestEditionSub: A spring–summer capsule curated by the editors
home.footerLine: A fashion platform of Western Ukraine. Uzhhorod — Lviv — onward.
home.quoteHero1: The west of Ukraine is not a geography.
home.quoteHero2: It is material, colour, and the silence between them.
